title: Show each verification record's workspace in the notes window
outcome: Show each verification record's workspace in the notes window
acceptance: Every verification note in `show --notes` output (CLI JSON and MCP) that carries typed verification facts includes an additive `source_workspace` field equal to the record's source_basis.workspace_id, copied verbatim and present exactly when source_revision is; notes without typed verification facts (generic or restored rows) carry neither field; the behaviour is documented beside source_revision.

Owned tests prove the field for a same-revision verification from another workspace, its absence on a note without verification facts, and that existing fields, rendered show text and note ordering are unchanged.

completion.summary: CLI JSON and MCP verification note reads now expose the recorded source workspace verbatim beside source revision, with regression coverage and documentation.
